appDesc.message: See a post worth keeping, click once, and it lands in your own Google Drive -- with optional sync to a Focus4ai knowledge base. Works on Facebook, Threads, X, Instagram and LinkedIn.

cmdCapture.message: Capture the post currently on screen (nothing is bound by default; set a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

brandTagline.message: Scroll to a post worth keeping. One click.

connWaiting.message: Waiting for the Google consent window...

connNonChrome.message: (On Arc, Brave or Edge, Drive authorisation needs Chrome itself. Capture and knowledge-base sync are unaffected.)

optFloatButton.message: Show the floating button on social pages

hintRightClick.message:
You can also **right-click a post and pick "⚡ Capture this post"** -- you point at exactly the one you mean, which is the least error-prone way.
For a keyboard shortcut, bind one yourself at **chrome://extensions/shortcuts**.

optAlbum.message: Page through album posts to collect every image

hintAlbum.message:
Facebook lays out only 5 thumbnails for an album post; the rest are not in the page at all. With this on, capturing an album **briefly opens the photo viewer** and pages through, then closes it and returns you to where you were.
This is the only feature that opens a popup window. Paging goes through the keyboard and it never clicks any menu inside the viewer. Turn it off and an album gives you the first 5 images only.

labelProfiles.message: Collection (each gets its own Drive folder)

optDriveEnabled.message: Write to Google Drive (one Doc per post, images embedded)

promptNewProfile.message: Name for the new collection (e.g. Client A, Reading, Industry watch)

profileAdded.message: Added. Remember to press Save settings.

optF4Private.message: Mark as local_only (never sent to an external model)

hintF4Private.message: Social posts are mostly public, so this is **off** by default -- that is what lets them into retrieval. Turn it on when you are collecting from a private group.

hintP2sCollect.message:
Off by default. With it on, the posts **you press capture on** also keep a copy of their text locally, which exports as the JSON persona-to-skill reads.
It never fetches anything you did not press, and it sends nothing anywhere. Where the file lands is decided by the button below.

hintP2sExport.message: The export **does not** fill in source tier or subject. Those two are yours to judge: which posts are the person's own words and which came from a social-media manager or a ghostwriter is not something a machine can see, which is why persona-to-skill forbids itself from guessing.

obStep1.message: 1. Connect Google (only needed for saving to Drive)

obStep1Body.message: Your content only ever lands in **your own** Drive. This extension has no server of its own.

obStep1Done.message: ✅ Connected. Everything you collect lands in your own Google Drive.

obStep2.message: 2. Try it on a social page

obStep2Body.message: Open any of the sites below and scroll to a post. **"⚡ Capture this"** floats in on its right, and that post gets a pale violet outline so you can see which one a click would take.

obStep2Alt.message: **Or** right-click a post and pick "⚡ Capture this post". You point at exactly the one you mean, which is the least error-prone way, and it still works when the floating button has not appeared.

obStep2Hotkey.message: For a keyboard shortcut, find Post Sync at **chrome://extensions/shortcuts** and bind one yourself. Nothing is bound by default, so it will not fight a shortcut you already use.

obStep3.message: 3. (Optional) sync to a Focus4ai knowledge base

obStep3Body.message: Click the Post Sync icon in the toolbar, turn on "Sync to a Focus4ai knowledge base", and fill in the site URL (the hosted site is **https://app.focus4ai.com**).

obStep3Why.message: Drive holds the version **for people to read**: one Doc per post, images embedded. The knowledge base holds the version **for retrieval**: Markdown, chunked and indexed on arrival so you can ask about it later.

obKnowTitle.message: A few things worth knowing up front

obKnowManual.message: **Every capture is one you pressed.** There is no automatic collection and it never scrolls the page for you. That would turn "a person reading" into "automated scraping", and the account risk is not remotely the same.

obKnowDup.message: **Capturing the same post twice asks you first.** It does not block you -- it asks, and hands you a link to the earlier copy.

obKnowDrift.message: **A platform redesign can throw the extraction off.** The selectors live in **src/adapters.js**, and when the body text cannot be found it says so on screen rather than pretending it collected something.

obKnowNoop.message: **Nothing happened when you clicked?** Go back to that tab and reload it with **Cmd+R** (**F5** on Windows). The extension needs the page to load again before it takes effect. Still nothing: click the icon and press "Check the current tab".
